verdict.rationale: Wise states its card lets you "pay and withdraw cash worldwide without any hidden fees or markups" (wise-docs-10). The docs also cover issuing debit cards worldwide and controlling ATM and other spending permissions (wise-docs-4, wise-docs-30). Missing for 10: a documented fee schedule (e.g. free ATM withdrawal limits or conversion fees), explicit confirmation that the claim covers the company/business card, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the no-hidden-fees claim.
